analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Open or expose a circular DLL as sentinel links plus dllseg, derive address inequalities from separated field ownership, split or concatenate segments around the anchor, normalize prefix ++ inserted :: anchor :: suffix, and close the DLL.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Use xizi_dll_links as the two-field ownership unit; split at the anchor for the entail witness and join prefix/local-chain/suffix for return witnesses.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Use explicit PreH non-null/distinctness facts, dllseg branch guards, and separation-derived node inequalities; no arithmetic or refinement obligations occur.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All three witnesses belong to one function, share one DLL segment helper family, and total only three witnesses, below the controller maximum of twelve.

proof_groups.grouping_reason: The three witnesses form one decomposition/rebuild proof cluster for the same function, reuse the same xizi_dll_links and xizi_dllseg helper family, and fit safely within max_witnesses_per_group=12.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: First prove group-suffixed spatial helpers for link-bundle inequality, arbitrary-prefix split at the anchor, and segment concatenation to the sentinel. Prove the entail witness by opening xizi_dll and destructing prefix into nil or prefix0 ++ [prev]. Prove return_wit_1 by selecting its left proposition, normalizing prefix, joining prefix0 with prev/inserted/anchor/suffix, and applying xizi_dll_close. Prove return_wit_2 as the nil-prefix base case by selecting its left proposition and folding two consecutive dllseg nodes before closing xizi_dll. Do not treat the diagnostics split goal as an assigned witness.
